skill_name: Explain the differences between the 7 Chakras.
workflow: The seven chakras are energetic points in our bodies that correspond to different areas of our physical and emotional health. The Root Chakra, also called the Muladhara, is located at the base of the spine and is associated with security and our connection to the physical world. The Sacral Chakra, or Svadhisthana, is located near the belly button and is associated with emotions, pleasure, and sexuality.
